Liam O'Connor: FYI — client NeonRail reported a weird charge: invoice shows negative credit line and total > expected. ticket#79401.
Priya Nambiar: they uploaded reserved credit earlier this month, right? could be double-applied during proration.
Zoe Park: grabbing invoice IDs and runs: inv_20260420_neon_A (issued) and inv_20260420_neon_fix (manual fix).
Liam O'Connor: customer says original expected total $950.00, issued $1,150.00, but also a -$200.00 credit line present. looks like rounding or swap of sign somewhere.
Priya Nambiar: logs show proration step applied reserved_credit_amount=200.00 but later settlement step applied same credit as a negative charge: ``settle: apply_line(amount=-20000 cents)`` -> sign flipped?
Zoe Park: paste: ```WARN 2026-04-20T03:14:12Z billing: proration: reserved_credit=20000 cents acct=neon id=acct_991
INFO 2026-04-20T03:14:12Z billing: ledger: create_line(type=credit, amount=20000)
ERROR 2026-04-20T03:14:13Z billing: settlement: unexpected negative net_line for invoice inv_20260420_neon_A -> auto-adjust````
Priya Nambiar: settlement's auto-adjust replaced the credit with a negative line but also re-computed taxes against gross incorrectly, adding $200 tax delta. result: customer sees both a credit line and a higher total.
Liam O'Connor: what's remediation? customer needs immediate corrected invoice and an apology.
Zoe Park: propose: 1) issue corrected invoice (regen with patched sign handling branch: fix/sign-ledger-proration), 2) create a compensating credit note for the tax delta, 3) flag ledger entries so they can't be double-applied.
FinanceBot: automated alert: created task FIN-10112 for compensating credit and replaced invoice for acct_991.
Priya Nambiar: finance approves compensating credit up to $300.00 and replacement invoice. please include internal audit note: "root cause: sign inversion during settlement auto-adjust after proration; fix deployed to branch."
Liam O'Connor: Zoe — can you run the regen dry-run and paste preview (redact charge ids)?
Zoe Park: dry-run preview: `{account: acct_991, period: 2026-04-01 to 2026-04-20, lines: [reserved-credit: -$200.00, compute-usage: $1150.00], taxes: $0.00, total: $950.00}` looks correct.
Liam O'Connor: great. I'll send customer note and attach the replacement invoice + credit note. tagging @FinanceBot to monitor acct_991 for 48h. :white_check_mark:
FinanceBot: monitoring enabled for acct_991 for 48 hours. will alert #finance on anomalies.
